text.en: A Jataka tale tells of a farmer who grew many fruits and decided to gift the best ones to the king. He chose grapes because watermelons were too heavy to carry far. When the playful king threw grapes at him, the farmer kept saying Thank God. In this chapter you will read why, learn words that are opposites, use is and are correctly, and put a fruit salad recipe in order.

A farmer who liked fruits decided to grow many kinds of fruit on his land. With hard work and care, his trees grew well, and he took special care of grapes and watermelons in a small corner. When the fruits were ripe, he wanted to gift the best fruit to the king. His wife said that the best fruits that year were the watermelons and the grapes. The journey to the palace was long and watermelons were too heavy, so the farmer put bunches of grapes in a basket and walked to the palace.
The guard took the farmer to the royal garden, where the king was playing with the princess. The farmer quietly put the basket in front of the king and sat down. When the king rested, the guard brought him the basket and said it was a gift from the farmer. The king was in a playful mood. He ate one grape and then threw another grape at the farmer. The grape hit the farmer on the forehead, and the farmer said Thank God.
The king was surprised and threw a grape again. Again the farmer said Thank God and called himself blessed. The king asked why he was thanking God when grapes were being thrown at him. The wise farmer smiled and explained that he had chosen the grapes over the watermelons. If he had brought watermelons, they would have hurt much more. So he was thankful for a small trouble instead of a big one. The story teaches us to look at the bright side and to be thankful.
A journey is a trip from one place to another. A guard protects a place and a royal garden is the garden of a king. Popped means put something quickly into the mouth. Wise means clever and sensible. Sight words like grow, kept, front and again are words you should recognise at once when reading.
Words that have the opposite meaning are called opposites. Heavy is the opposite of light. A thick book is opposed by a thin book. A long journey is opposed by a short journey. Soft cotton is opposed by hard rock, and a slow tortoise by a fast rabbit. Other pairs are hot and cold, big and small, up and down.
We use is when we speak about one thing and are when we speak about more than one. The table is made of wood, because there is one table. These mangoes are sweet, because there are many mangoes. The toys are on the shelf, but the book is on the table. I is not used with is, we say I am.
A funny poem tells of an elephant with a mighty cold who needs a handkerchief the size of a bed sheet. If you visit a sick elephant, you could take fruits, warm soup or tulsi tea, and say them aloud. Chandu mixed up the steps of making a fruit salad. First he takes banana slices, next papaya cubes, then apple slices, then grapes, then he mixes them, and finally he squeezes lemon with a pinch of salt. The word search has fruits such as mango, papaya, grapes, banana, guava, plum, peach and pear.

problem.en: Write the opposite of the underlined word: a long journey.

text.en: Look at the underlined word: long.

why.en: Long tells the length of the journey.

text.en: The opposite of long is short.
So the phrase is a short journey.

problem.en: Fill in is or are: The girls ___ at the shop.

text.en: Girls means more than one.
So we write: The girls are at the shop.

why.en: For one girl we would write: The girl is at the shop.

problem.en: Put in order: A. Then I mix them all. B. First I take banana slices. C. Finally I squeeze a lemon.

text.en: The first step has the word first: B.
Then comes mixing: A.

why.en: Mixing is done after adding the fruits.

text.en: Finally comes the lemon: C. The order is B, A, C.

why.en: Words like first, then and finally show the order.

prompt.en: Tell the story of the farmer and the king and explain why the farmer said Thank God.

requiredIdeas.en: The farmer took grapes as a gift
The king threw grapes at him
Be thankful and look at the bright side

commonMisconceptions.en: The farmer did not bring a gift

points.en: The farmer gifted grapes because watermelons were too heavy.
He said Thank God because grapes hurt less than watermelons.
Opposites have opposite meanings: heavy and light.
Use is for one and are for more than one.
Words like first, next and finally show the order of steps.
